title: Streamlined weekly cut and hotfix branching strategy
creator: Maya Patel
description: Background: Our current weekly release cadence produces RCs every Wednesday with a manual cut and ad-hoc hotfix branches. This has caused ambiguity about which commits land in LTS channels, inconsistent RC tagging, and frequent manual steps to generate release notes. Goal: Define a deterministic weekly cut process plus explicit hotfix branch rules, automate RC tagging and release-notes generation, and provide upgrade tooling to simplify customer upgrades between weekly and LTS channels. Scope: release train cadence, RC tag semantics, branching strategy for hotfixes, gating checks (CI/signing/smoke), automated changelog/release notes pipeline, and a small CLI to validate upgrade plan for customers. Out of scope: full UI in the Console for rollouts (follow-up project). Constraints: keep changes backward-compatible for Dedicated and Private deployments, integrate with existing CI (github/actions), and maintain auditability for compliance.
acceptance_criteria: A documented weekly cut checklist that fits within a 90-minute window
RC tags are created automatically by the release-bot and follow semantic rules (v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>-rc.<N>)
Hotfix branches follow the documented naming convention and are merged by a signed PR process
Release notes are generated from merged PR metadata and a curated highlights file, published to the release page automatically
Canary rollout policy initiated after RC promotion with automated smoke tests and rollback on failure
A lightweight upgrade-validator CLI that can validate a customer's pinned model/version against the upcoming release and surface breaking changes
comments: 2026-02-21 - Spike: evaluated three release-note generators (conventional-changelog, release-drafter, custom parser). Recommend release-drafter with a small post-process step to include curated highlights.

2026-02-25 - Design review: presented branching rules and RC tag format to release-eng and infra. Agreed to use 'hotfix/x.y.z' and 'vX.Y.Z-rc.N' tagging. Feedback: add a gate for signed artifacts before tag creation.

2026-03-02 - Implementation: initial release-bot changes landed in github.com/redwood-inference/release-bot#42 (PR: 1234). Bot now drafts RC tags but waits on 'signed-artifact' CI job before creating the tag.
2026-03-08 - Testing: ran two simulated weekly cuts in staging. Observed flaky smoke test at canary 5% on model shard rotation; filed ENG-9901 to investigate shard stability under canary load.
2026-03-10 - Security review kickoff: submitted security checklist and audit plan to security-team (see Confluence link). Waiting on HSM signing confirmation.

2026-03-12 - Blocker: release-builder image bump required to include the new changelog templating tools. Infra owner (Priya Rangan) is tracking a rollout; tagging of this ticket will wait for infra window 2026-03-16.
